methodology.price: Bybit public v5 market ticker, linear USDT perpetual symbol.
methodology.history: Bybit public v5 daily kline, linear USDT perpetual symbol, latest 120 candles requested.
methodology.returns: Current public price compared with recent public daily close history at 7d, 30d, and 90d lookbacks.
methodology.realizedVol: Sample standard deviation of adjacent spot returns in the last 30 calendar days; large gaps are not bridged.
methodology.ewma: Recursive EWMA over adjacent spot returns with lambda = 0.94; large gaps are not bridged.
methodology.historicalVaR: Empirical 5th percentile over the latest 30 adjacent spot returns ending on the snapshot date.
